scope.round_trip_identity: Native numeric IDs become new QuPath UUIDs; compare objects by unique fixture name.
scope.serialization: Record created and QuPath-decoded geometry/masks separately; upstream coordinate quantization can change pixel membership.
verified_edge_conditions: Half-pixel hole boundary membership and counts, including 1874 covered centers for geometric area 1850

ellipse_length.policy: Use a separate 0.05% engineering budget for ellipse lengths, report the actual relative error and check the native value independently by dense quadrature. Other geometry tolerances are unchanged.

subpixel_export.name: Subpixel boundary
subpixel_export.policy: Compare native import to QuPath decoding of the same GeoJSON. Retain pre-export geometry and masks separately to expose upstream quantization.

unmet_gates.name: very_thin_ellipse_decoded_geometry_parity
unmet_gates.policy: Do not widen coordinate/area tolerances. Report the native raw analytic envelope and QuPath float/repair-decoded envelope separately. This known disagreement keeps the overall comparison partial.
